description: The pie chart presents the distribution of video/content categories, showing 14 slices in total, each labeled with an in-slice percentage. The categories and approximate proportions are: People Blogs (orange, 17.2%), Entertainment (purple, 13.9%), Howto Style (green, 9.7%), Education (red, 8.7%), Sports (pink, 7.7%), Gaming (gray, 6.4%), Science Technology (blue, 6.4%), Comedy (cyan, 5.6%), Travel Events (yellow-green, 4.6%), Film Animation (brown, 4.6%), News Politics (orange, 4.3%), Pets Animals (green, 3.9%), Autos Vehicles (red, 4.8%), and Music (light purple, 2.3%). There is no separate legend; labels are placed around the pie with percentages printed inside the slices, and no segments appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized.
